data.name: Jamuh
data.long_meaning: The name Jamuh is derived from the Arabic root word 'J-M-H', meaning 'to gather' or 'community'. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) used the term 'Jamah' to describe the collective Muslim ummah. This name is a reminder of the unity and bond among the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jamuh represents unity, community, and togetherness. It is believed that those named Jamuh will be blessed with the ability to bring people together and create a strong bond among them.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Jamuh tend to be adaptable, versatile, and have a strong sense of community. They have a natural ability to bring people together and are often seen as peacemakers.

in_arabic.name: جموح
in_arabic.meaning: الجموع يعني الجماعة أو المجموعة من الناس أو الأشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الجموح في اللغة العربية يعني الجماعة أو المجموعة من الناس أو الأشياء، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى الجمع والتجميع. وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي كونه يدل على الوحدة والتلاحم.

in_urdu.name: جموع
in_urdu.meaning: جموع کا مطلب ہے گروہ یا لوگوں یا چیزوں کا مجموعہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کی root ج م ع سے بننے والا نام جموع، اردو میں بھی اسی معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام گروہ یا لوگوں کے مجموعے کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے کیونکہ یہ اتحاد اور ملاپ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जमूह
in_hindi.meaning: जमूह का अर्थ है समूह या लोगों या वस्तुओं का संग्रह
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ समूह या संग्रह होता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है क्योंकि यह एकता और समूह भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: جموج
in_pashto.meaning: جموج دى ګروپ یا د خلکو یا شیانو مجموعه معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې د جموج نوم معنی د ګروپ یا د خلکو او شیانو راټولونه دي. دا نوم د پښتنو په کلتور کې د يوالي او ګډوونې د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Jamuh
in_english.meaning: Jamuh means a group or collection of people or things
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jamuh originates from the Arabic root 'ج م ع' (jam'a), meaning to gather or collect. It signifies a group or community, emphasizing unity and togetherness. In Islamic tradition, Jamuh represents the coming together of people in harmony.

It emphasizes the importance of collective action, cooperation, and social cohesion within the Muslim community. The name Jamuh inspires a sense of belonging, identity, and inclusiveness among Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jamuh is deeply rooted in the Islamic principle of Tawheed or the Oneness of God. It reminds Muslims of the shared belief and submission to Allah, which unites them as one Ummah. Jamuh also symbolizes the communal aspect of Islam, emphasizing the importance of gathering in the mosque for communal prayers, learning, and socializing. The name serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness and interdependence among Muslims and their shared commitment to the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
